title: A City Full of Suspicious Perverts

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and the others regained consciousness. When they came to, they somehow found themselves in Landosol.

って、

text_block_list.text: They're so terrified of the zombies that they're panicking. Let's save them. Young lady Kyouka, let's go with "Plan B".

パニックに陥っています。

キョウカお嬢様、

text_block_list.text: Just like last time, this is the first time I've heard of it! But I'm used to it now!

でももう慣れましたよ！

text_block_list.name: Kyouka Grace
text_block_list.text: YAAAAH!" "HAAA!
text_block_list.orig_text:

「はぁ！」

text_block_list.name: Zombies Without Reason

text_block_list.name: Kyoka

text_block_list.orig_text:
ミミ、
ミソギ。

text_block_list.name: Misogi
text_block_list.text: Everyone?! What in the world happened?
text_block_list.orig_text:

text_block_list.name: Mimi
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so those are zombies. I thought they were some suspicious perverts since they were drooling while chasing me around.

ヨダレをたらしておいかけてくるから、

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: But the question is how to fight while protecting the city... There's so many zombies around and the soldiers don't seem to have enough manpower to handle them all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どう街を守りながら戦うかですよね……
ゾンビが多くて、
兵士さんの手が足りていないようでした。

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: You're right... Now is the time for unity. Will you all lend us your strength once more?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい……
今こそ連帯の力が必要です。
改めて、

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Of course." "At once." "It's givensh!" "Obviously!" "As you wish.

「もちろん。」「もちろんでしゅ。」
「もちろんです。」「もちろん！」「御意。」

text_block_list.name: Grace
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Now, let's split into groups based on our objectives. Master Knight, Milady, Lului and I will focus all our efforts on defeating the villainess.

では

騎士氏、
お嬢様、
ルルィ、
私は、

姫、
おじい様、

text_block_list.name: Duran
text_block_list.text: As ordered. It is time to show off my skills as a knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:

text_block_list.orig_text:

へんたいふしんしゃさん破滅エンドは回避ですね。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, {0} and his companions defeated the descendant of "Our Ladies of Sorrow" and her minions. The magical chain that had been tormenting Grace and Kyouka also disappeared, and the two were finally free.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、
嘆きの聖母たちの眷属を打倒した{0}たち。
グレイスとキョウカを苦しめていた魔力の鎖も消えてなくなり、
二人は晴れて自由の身になったのであった。
